description: Change a field that is there without moving any value: its displayName, helpText (null takes it away) and required. A group field: addFields puts new sub-fields after the ones it has (the shape of add_field's group.fields; a new key is the lowercase, hyphenated name, and a name whose key the group has is refused), editFields relabels the ones it has by key (displayName, helpText, required). A components field: allow adds component types its blocks may be (add_component_type makes one), disallow takes some out — refused while a record holds a block of the type. A sub-field's key, type and sensitivity stay as they are. What moves values is a person's decision: removing a field is remove_field, a new key rename_field, another type convert_field; taking a sub-field out of a group or changing its type is done in Mapled. A component type's own sub-fields change with update_component_type.

addFields.description: For a group field: new sub-fields, after the ones it has. A group holds up to 20.

sensitive.description: Masked in lists and history and never delivered to the site — this sub-field's values stay with the editors.

allow.description: For a components field: keys of component types (get_schema's componentTypes) to allow as well.

disallow.description: For a components field: keys of component types to stop allowing.

editFields.description: For a group field: sub-fields it has, by key, and what changes in each.

key.description: The sub-field's key, as get_schema lists it.

name: update_field
